description: Suno Studio effect. Lifts silky air, controls low-mid body, tilts the tone from intimate to chamber size, and adds gentle saturation for weight. Apply to the rendered STRINGS stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Lifts silky air, controls low-mid body, tilts the tone from intimate to chamber size, and adds gentle saturation for weight.

air.description: High-shelf lift near 10kHz for silky top-end air.
air.label: Air

body.description: Low-shelf control near 300Hz for low-mid body; cut to thin or boost to thicken.
body.label: Body

size/tilt.description: Tilt pair that shifts the balance from intimate/close toward larger chamber size.
size/tilt.label: Size

saturation.description: Gentle drive into the tanh stage for body and weight.
saturation.label: Sat

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
